revision: Selected price facts with explicit reconfirmation
fixture: Each selected item has a 1000-pence variant and 100-pence modifier, quantity one. Only the first selected item changes.
oracle: Unchanged/unrelated total 1100*n; increase 1100*n+200; decrease 1100*n-200; modifier 1100*n+50. Unavailable/deleted option reject. Second-change A accepts +200 immediately; B requires two confirmations then accepts +300. No production pricing helper is used by the checker.
comparisonUnit: One scripted checkout, including any explicit confirmations; paired by round, condition and cart size.
timing: Local API elapsed time, server table/menu-validation duration, and entire scripted checkout duration are separate measures. There is no simulated human thinking delay.
boundary: Validation does not reserve menu availability until insert. Accepted snapshots survive later edits. Tests use synthetic local data only.
